# Vendored third-party code

Everything the showroom runs is self-hosted (CSP: `script-src 'self'` + the import-map hash + `'wasm-unsafe-eval'`;
no CDN, no new origins). Nothing here is executed server-side: imghost only serves these files (tower-http
`ServeDir`, no listing, traversal blocked, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`; see `tests/integration.rs`).

### Derived: `addons/libs/basis/ktx2_inline.js`

Generated by `tools/showroom/build_ktx2_worker.mjs` from KTX2Loader's worker source (constants +
basis_transcoder.js + `KTX2Loader.BasisWorker`), wrapped as an ES module that `js/ktx2.js` runs in the page as a
Worker-shaped object. Why not a worker: three starts it from a `blob:` URL (needs `worker-src blob:`), and the
emscripten/embind glue builds two glue functions with `Function()` (needs `'unsafe-eval'`) — under our CSP the
transcoder never initialised. The build replaces those two (`craftInvokerFunction`, `__emval_get_method_caller`)
with emscripten's closure-based equivalents (what `-sDYNAMIC_EXECUTION=0` emits) and fails if any `Function(`/`eval(`
remains. Result: no workers, no blob:, no eval; only WebAssembly compile, already allowed by `'wasm-unsafe-eval'`.
Verified under the real imghost CSP (all five halls, zero CSP violations). Re-run the script after re-vendoring three.

  `a8781bad05f9624edbf910b7f258cd0a4ba7d3e63b49ecc0a0ab440bf6a0a245` (matches the GitHub release asset digest),
  sha1 `c6b08c817f8c8dd299deccae4f2fbb8d55e9acd2` (matches the published `.sha1`; no signature is published).
